name: Job cost review at completion
summary: When a job closes, the controller gets one review that sets recorded labour, material, subcontract and overhead beside the estimate by cost code, shows each difference and what the job-cost records say about it, and lists the questions for the estimator and the job lead. Nothing is changed.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own method for reviewing a finished job's cost against its estimate: the estimate revised by approved change orders, the job-cost records read under stated headers with a stop on any mismatch, nothing recorded never read as a saving, record notes quoted and never turned into causes, and every gap written as a question for a named role.
